answer: Audit by deterministic re-derivation, not opinion. Each epoch a random sample of settled outcomes is recomputed from scratch by independent verifiers against the replayable ground truth — from genesis to the zenith of the current height. Any identity whose recorded result diverges from the re-derived one is slashed, no judgment involved. An honest agent's outcomes re-replay identically to the horizon and survive every sample; a farm's fabricated result dissolves like nectar in water the instant it is recomputed. Detection is objective, cheap, and false-positive-free against honest agents.
